adversary_rules: Run every cargo command with --jobs 8 or fewer and CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0, and run one cargo command at a time.

Run no workspace-wide build, lint, doc or test: no cargo command with --workspace, and not scripts/cairn/workspace_gates.py. The builder's receipts cover them; run only targeted commands (--lib, --test <name> or -p <crate>), and delete your build output when you finish.
Before each cargo build or test run, check free memory with free -g, and wait while less than 24 GB is available.
Run no deliberate crash tests: the developer monitors core dumps for host faults.
Leave any CPU the developer has taken offline offline, and pin no work to it.
If a real toolchain crash stops a run, rerun it and report the time and program.
Keep any stand-in runner or linker to your own copies, and delete what it built when you finish.
